cap.doc: The restraint (FeelBudget, lane n7-ranged): however many hits land, at most kicks_per_tick directional kicks start in one sim tick, shakes_per_second shakes and hitstop_ticks_per_second hit-stop ticks in any 60-tick window; the summed kick never passes kick_px_max screen px.

classes.doc: Pistol, machine pistol, nails: a flash and a flinch, no stop (rate of fire would stutter).
Hand cannon, the claw combo finisher.
Rockets, the Hauler stomp, a wrecked car.
Flame puffs and fire patches: burning drives panic, not a flinch per tick.
Melee (n7-melee REQUEST 1): the combo finisher, a katana or sword cut: a longer stop and a bigger kick than a jab.
Ghosts (n7-melee REQUEST 1): the Tonnage press or a boss slam: the long stop, the explosion shake, a radial kick per victim (strength by distance).
Ghosts (n7-melee REQUEST 1): a body ram (Gearbox, a charging boss): the crash shake, strength by speed.
Ghosts (n7-melee REQUEST 1): one Kerf cut in a chain: a 2-tick stop and no shake, so the chain reads cut by cut.
Ghosts (n7-melee REQUEST 1): an Ohm arc past its first victim: the flash and a small kick only (the first victim takes `shock`).

doc: Shared hit feel (lane gunplay): one row per damage class, used by guns, melee and ghost powers alike. hitstop and shake name camera.json ids (the rig scales both to 0 under reduced motion and enforces the hit-stop cooldown); a lethal hit uses kill_hitstop instead. reaction is the hook enemy-ai plays. Under a beat mode (a scripted kill beat, d5-combat REQUEST 3) a lethal hit uses beat_kill_hitstop (boss_hit, 8 ticks) instead of kill (6). Lane n7-ranged: kick_px / kick_ticks are a directional camera kick along the hit (screen px at any zoom, easing back over the ticks; FeelCam), kill_kick_scale makes a kill kick harder, `weapons` overrides a class's hitstop / shake / kick per weapon id, and `cap` is the restraint (FeelBudget). --feel=off turns every camera effect of a hit off (before clips). fire_kick_px / fire_kick_ticks (weapons rows) kick the camera against the aim on each round Rivet fires.

weapons.doc: About 15 rounds a second: no stop and no shake per round (the class's 3-tick stop would stutter at the cooldown); a small kick each, held steady by the cap. Fire: a 1.8 px kick against the aim per round (4 ticks; 0.7 measured +0.07 px rms, unreadable), so sustained fire is a steady rumble under the 1-kick-per-tick cap, never a blur. Spin-up: a tremor growing to 1.5 px while the barrels come up to speed (0.5 s), the anticipation before the first round; it fades the same way on the wind-down.
The heavy single shot: a bigger kick than its class. Fire: a 2 px recoil kick.
Several shards land together: no per-shard stop (the kill still stops).
Rate of fire: a smaller kick than the pistol.
The biggest hit in the arsenal: the long stop, the full kick and its own deeper, longer shake (camera.json nuke).
Fire: the launch shoves the camera 3 px back along the tube (10 ticks); the hit keeps its blast class.
